excerpt: It has an active mass of 50 kg Ar, representing the first large-scale use of low-radioactivity argon from underground sources. DarkSide-50 construction was completed in late 2012, with physics data collection beginning in late 2013, using atmospheric argon (AAr). [detector] subsequently filled with underground argon in April 2015.
title: DS-50 - DarkSide Collaboration
